items.detail: Crew mobilization, access setup and containment plan
Vacuum recovery of oily water within the contained area
Container handling, transport and disposal charges
Post-work sampling, laboratory analysis and field report

scope: Temporary containment and recovery at one shoreline work area. Creek-wide remediation and dredging are excluded.
terms: Net 14. All charges are included in the fixed contract price. Any change to the invoiced amount requires an approved written change order.
closeout: Closeout records required: daily crew logs, waste manifests and water-sampling results.
disclaimer: Fictional demo invoice. Contractor, client, work and prices are invented. Not payable.
